visit.sectionHint: Send a grandparent or sitter one home's list. They tick what they did on their own phone and send you a short reply. Nothing is uploaded.
visit.sendIntro: Your helper opens the link in any browser. No app and no account. The link holds the task list and your first name, never birth dates, emergency cards or photos.
visit.fromError: Enter just your first name (letters only, no spaces).
visit.packError: Could not make the visit pack.
visit.packText: {from} asked for your help with a short home checklist for {home}.
visit.packShared: Link shared. It will wait below for a reply.
visit.packCopied: Link copied. Paste it into a message. It will wait below for a reply.
visit.manual: Copy this link and send it yourself:
visit.title: {from} asked for your help at {home}
visit.intro: Here are a few things to do around the house for a child {stage}. Tick each one when it is done.
visit.private: Nothing you tick is uploaded. It stays on this phone until you send the reply link.
visit.sentBy: Sent by {from} with GrowSafe. No app, no account.
visit.easyOffer: Turn on Easy mode (bigger text and buttons)
visit.nameError: Enter just your first name (letters only, no spaces).
visit.sendHint: Tick something first, then you can send it back.
visit.copied: Reply link copied. Paste it into a message. Thank you.
visit.bad: This visit link looks damaged or incomplete. Ask for a new one.
merge.bad: This reply link looks damaged or incomplete. Ask your helper to send it again.
merge.nothing: {by} sent a reply with nothing new to add
merge.unknownPack: This phone has no record of sending that pack. Tasks that match are still updated.
merge.private: Nothing was uploaded. Your plan changes only when you tap Confirm.
